io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.items.autocrafters

Class ArmorAutoCrafter

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.SlimefunItem
      • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.items.autocrafters.AbstractAutoCrafter
        • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.items.autocrafters.SlimefunAutoCrafter
          • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.items.autocrafters.ArmorAutoCrafter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    EnergyNetComponent, ItemAttribute, Placeable

    public class ArmorAutoCrafter
extends SlimefunAutoCrafter
    The ArmorAutoCrafter is an implementation of the AbstractAutoCrafter. It can craft items that are crafted using the ArmorForge.
    See Also:
    ArmorForge, AbstractAutoCrafter, SlimefunAutoCrafter, SlimefunItemRecipe
